name: Lexara — AI for Legal Access & Assistance
description: A GenAI-powered platform that makes legal information accessible by simplifying complex legal documents, comparing contracts and policies, highlighting important clauses and risks, answering questions from provided documents, generating actionable summaries and checklists, and helping users prepare questions for a legal professional. Provides information and assistance, never a substitute for professional legal advice.
useCases: Simplifying complex legal documents into plain language at multiple reading levels
Comparing contracts, agreements, or policies with deterministic paragraph-level diff
Highlighting important clauses, obligations, risks, and inconsistencies across 16 risk categories
Answering questions based on provided legal documents with grounded citations
Helping users understand their options and potential next steps
Generating summaries, checklists, and actionable outputs via the Lawyer Prep Sheet
Helping users prepare specific questions for a legal professional

architecture.frontend: Vanilla JavaScript ES Modules, HTML5, CSS3
architecture.ai: Groq API — LLaMA 3.3 70B Versatile with 3-model fallback ladder

aiUsage.description: Rewrites complex legal documents in plain language at user-selected reading level with KEY POINTS summary
Explains flagged clauses in plain language, grounded in exact document text
Explains practical significance of deterministically detected document changes
Answers questions strictly from loaded document text with citations
Generates 8 document-specific questions for attorney consultation grounded in flagged clause language

security: Client-side PDF parsing — raw files never transmitted to server
Prompt injection filtering — 6 patterns applied client-side and server-side
Two-tier rate limiting — 100 req/min general, 20 req/min AI endpoints
Full security header set including strict CSP with no unsafe-inline scripts
API key server-side only — never exposed to client bundle
Input validation and XSS sanitization on all AI output
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA — skip links, ARIA landmarks, keyboard navigation, prefers-reduced-motion, 4.5:1 contrast ratios, 3 reading-level options
testing: 63 zero-dependency tests covering clause detection, document diffing, server validation, rate limiter, injection patterns, model ladder logic
